clauses.heading: Leverage
clauses.text:
22.1 Leverage
Test frequency: quarterly, at quarter end.
From 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30, the Borrower shall ensure Net Debt / LTM EBITDA shall not exceed 4.0 ratio.
From 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31, the Borrower shall ensure Net Debt / LTM EBITDA shall not exceed 3.5 ratio.

clauses.heading: Interest cover
clauses.text:
22.2 Interest cover
Test frequency: quarterly, at quarter end.
From 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, the Borrower shall ensure LTM EBITDA / interest expense shall not be less than 3.0 ratio.

clauses.heading: Debt service coverage
clauses.text:
22.3 Debt service coverage
Test frequency: quarterly, at quarter end.
From 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, the Borrower shall ensure cash available for debt service / debt service shall not be less than 1.2 ratio.

clauses.heading: Minimum net worth
clauses.text:
22.4 Minimum net worth
Test frequency: quarterly, at quarter end.
From 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, the Borrower shall ensure tangible net worth shall not be less than 50000000 currency.

clauses.heading: Current ratio
clauses.text:
22.5 Current ratio
Test frequency: quarterly, at quarter end.
From 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, the Borrower shall ensure current assets / current liabilities shall not be less than 1.5 ratio.

clauses.heading: Capital expenditure
clauses.text:
22.6 Capital expenditure
Test frequency: quarterly, at quarter end.
From 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, the Borrower shall ensure quarterly capex shall not exceed 20000000 currency.

clauses.heading: Interest margin
clauses.text:
30.1 Interest margin
The applicable interest margin is 2.0 percent per annum.

clauses.heading: Commitment fee
clauses.text:
30.2 Commitment fee
The commitment fee is 0.5 percent on the undrawn amount.
